comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In honor of Atlantis' brief return... This title is awarded to those who have completed 10 floors of an endless dungeon -- The Labyrinth on Crete, or the Temple of Poseidon in the Acropolis of Atlantis.

To obtain it, simply clear 10 floors in a single run of the endless dungeon of your choice (either through fighting enemies or gimmick torch use) and the title becomes yours to use right away. As stamina restoring items don't work in endless dungeons, it helps you survive a little better.

Note that the Acropolis of Atlantis and its dungeon isn't always available in-game, but the Labyrinth is always there. (Also uglier. Meh.) Cheers.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Does anyone know if this title stucks with Sagaris?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
It does, according to an Atlantis guide which covers both Deepseeker title and Sagaris. I've tested the combination myself and found it to work as well.
